title: Corporate Headshot Studio in India: Pricing & Booking Guide

children.text: A good corporate headshot studio in India gets your whole team photographed consistently, on schedule, with images ready for LinkedIn the same week. Here's what to look for and what it typically costs.

layout.content: Corporate Headshot Studio in India: Pricing & Booking Guide

Finding the right corporate headshot studio in India means balancing three things most companies get wrong on the first try: consistent lighting across every employee, a schedule that doesn't eat half the office's workday, and a studio that can actually handle a group booking without turning it into a logistics headache. Whether you're refreshing LinkedIn photos for a 40-person sales team or shooting leadership portraits for an annual report, the studio you pick decides how smooth that day goes.
Why a Studio Beats an Office Corner for Headshots

It's tempting to set up a backdrop in a conference room and call it done, but office lighting is rarely consistent enough for a professional result. Fluorescent ceiling lights create uneven skin tones, window light shifts through the day, and a plain wall rarely photographs as cleanly as an actual seamless backdrop.

A dedicated studio solves this with controlled lighting that stays identical from the first employee to the fiftieth. That consistency matters more than people expect — a team page or company directory looks unprofessional fast when half the photos are warm-toned and half are cool-toned because they were shot at different times of day near a window.
What to Look for in a Corporate Headshot Studio
Before booking, confirm the studio can actually support a multi-person corporate shoot rather than just a single portrait session:

items: A clean, consistent backdrop option — white, grey, or a solid brand colour — with enough space to swap backdrops if needed.
A lighting setup built for faces: typically a key light, a fill light, and a hair or rim light, not a single harsh source.
Enough waiting area so employees aren't standing in a hallway between their turn in front of the camera.
A fast turnaround workflow — tethered shooting so someone from HR or marketing can approve shots on the spot, rather than waiting days to find out a retake is needed.
Reliable power backup, especially for shoots running a full day with multiple lighting setups.
Changing space if some employees are swapping blazers or outfits between shots.

layout.content: Planning a Group or Team Headshot Shoot

The biggest difference between a single headshot booking and a corporate one is scheduling. Most studios can comfortably shoot one person every 3 to 5 minutes once lighting is locked, which means a 40-person team can realistically be done in 3 to 4 hours — but only if people arrive on a staggered schedule rather than all at once.

Share a time-slot sheet with your team in advance, build in a 10-15 minute buffer every hour for people who run late, and ask the studio whether they can provide a second camera angle or quick wardrobe check between sitters. For leadership portraits that need more polish than standard employee headshots, book those separately with extra time per person rather than squeezing them into the same rapid-fire slots.
The fastest corporate headshot shoots aren't the ones with the best camera — they're the ones with the tightest schedule and a studio that keeps lighting locked between sitters.
Pricing for Corporate Headshot Studios in India

Studio rental for headshot sessions in India generally follows the same hourly logic as any other photography studio booking, with mid-range studios typically running from roughly ₹1,500 to ₹5,000 per hour depending on the city and the studio's size. For a corporate shoot, most companies book a half-day or full-day block rather than paying by the headshot, since a half-day slot comfortably covers 15-25 people once lighting is set.

On top of studio rental, factor in the photographer's fee separately — many studios list space rental and photography as separate line items — plus any retouching cost if you want every image lightly edited rather than delivered straight out of camera. Group bookings often get better per-person rates than single-sitting bookings, so it's worth asking the studio directly rather than assuming the individual headshot price scales linearly.
Getting Consistent, LinkedIn-Ready Results

For the images to actually look uniform across a whole team, agree on a few basics before the shoot day: one backdrop colour for everyone, a consistent crop (head-and-shoulders works for most profile photos), and a dress code guideline so the team doesn't show up in a mix of casual and formal wear. Ask the studio or photographer to shoot a few test frames first and get sign-off from whoever owns the brand guidelines before the full team starts sitting.

If the goal is specifically LinkedIn or website bio photos, remember the final crop will often be square or near-square, so leave headroom in the frame rather than shooting tight — it's easier to crop down later than to recover lost headroom.
FAQs: Corporate Headshot Studios in India
How much does a corporate headshot shoot cost in India?

It depends heavily on studio rental time, photographer fees, and retouching, but a half-day studio booking covering 15-25 employees is a common benchmark companies plan around. Ask for a combined quote covering studio time, photography, and basic retouching rather than estimating per person.
How long does a single corporate headshot session take?

Once lighting is set, most studios can shoot one person in 3 to 5 minutes. The bigger time factor is scheduling — staggered arrival times keep the whole shoot moving far faster than everyone showing up at once.
What should employees wear for corporate headshots?

Solid colours photograph more cleanly than busy patterns or logos, and matching the general formality level across the team (all blazers, or all smart-casual) keeps the final set looking consistent on a team page or directory.
Can a studio shoot both individual headshots and group team photos in one booking?

Most studios can, but it's worth telling them in advance so they can plan backdrop changes and extra setup time. Group shots usually need a wider lens and a different lighting spread than tight individual headshots.
How soon can we get the final retouched photos back?

Turnaround depends on the studio and how much retouching is requested, but many studios can deliver lightly edited images within a week for straightforward corporate packages. Ask for the turnaround time upfront if you have a launch date or annual report deadline.

Final Takeaways

A corporate headshot shoot runs smoothly when the studio, the lighting, and the schedule are all locked before anyone shows up. Treat it less like a single photo session and more like a short, well-planned production day.

items: Choose a studio with consistent lighting and a clean backdrop suited to headshots, not a repurposed general-purpose set.
Book a half-day or full-day block for group shoots rather than per-person slots.
Stagger employee arrival times and build in buffer slots to avoid a backlog.
Agree on backdrop colour, crop, and dress code across the team before shoot day.
Confirm retouching and turnaround time upfront so photos are ready when you need them.
